content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Could you please tell me your postcode?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your motor premium has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Your home premium has 360.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your health premium has 720.00 past due and is 8 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount for all of them together today?
Not all of them. I paid the motor arrears yesterday and the home premium isn't mine, but I'll pay the health premium today.
I have noted the health premium for 720.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. Could you pay 480.00 for the motor premium on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I already paid the motor arrears yesterday, so there's nothing to pay on that one. Today I'm only paying the health premium.
Thank you. Please note that posting may take two business days. Could you pay 360.00 for the home premium on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, that home premium isn't mine, so I won't be paying it. I'm only paying the health premium today.
I have noted that. To confirm: the health premium, 720.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm the health premium only.
Your promise is recorded: the health premium, 720.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. A premium-promise receipt will be placed in the secure inbox. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything for now, thank you. Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
